Claim 1 (Currently amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __wherein said open rib structure includes fore-aft ribs and transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said fore-aft ribs__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

Claim 2 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner.

Claim 3 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure.

Claim 4 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure.

Claim 5 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

Claim 6 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

Claim 7 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.

Claim 8 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel.

Claim 9 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress.

Claim 10 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress.

Claim 11 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa.

Claim 12 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers.

Claim 13 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3.5 mm.

Claim 14 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2.5 mm.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress __wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib and said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure.

Claim 16 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners.

Claim 17 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

Claim 19 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

Claim 20 (Previously presented): The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.
